basic_info.description: This rare two-level NoPa townhome-style condo blends thoughtful updates, scale, and a house-like feel in a quiet yet central setting. Detached on three sides, No. 8 is accessed through a private courtyard entry with deeded patio, set back from the street for peace and privacy with a boutique, hotel-like ambiance.    Inside, soaring 9-foot ceilings, custom millwork, wide plank wood floors, and bright dual-pane windows frame the open living and dining spaces anchored by a gas-burning fireplace. The updated kitchen offers sleek finishes, stainless steel appliances, and new counters, complemented by in-unit laundry and a remodeled luxe bath on the main level.   Upstairs, a nearly 500-square-foot private bedroom level impresses with a spa-like bath, large walk-in closet, and flexible office/sitting area bathed in natural light. Secure parking, professional management, and a 2001-built elevator building add everyday convenience. A pet-friendly, 11-unit HOA completes the package.   All just blocks from USF, the Panhandle, Golden Gate Park, Trader Joe's, Target, and NOPA's many cafes and restaurants - a stylish, functional, and rare offering in one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods.
